verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI document at amplitude.com/openapi.json, and the docs describe an Experiment management API for creating and controlling flags and experiments. However, nothing shows that this spec covers the Experiment APIs, and no first-party docs point users to it. Missing for 10: evidence that the OpenAPI spec covers the Experiment management, Holdout and Mutex APIs, first-party documentation of the spec download, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
